_editing: Add new releases to the front of the 'releases' array. The first release is featured on the home page. Add cover art to /public/releases and set 'cover' to its path (e.g. "/releases/another-time.jpg") — when 'cover' is empty the site renders a styled vinyl disc instead. Per-track 'links' and 'duration' are optional.

releases.title: Another Time
releases.description: The debut 13-track digital album from Ange's Rant — a homage to the artists that shaped Ange's musical journey, made possible by the creative contribution and skills of his talented musician friends. Funk, soul and disco/pop with an 80's flavour, front to back.
